short_description: Cedar Health — a value-based-care system's readmission-and-intervention rescue. Post-discharge care gaps pushed a cohort of recently-discharged heart-failure patients into rising 30-day readmission risk, faster than the batch report could surface. A care-coordinator app reads governed clinical data at low latency, an intervention recommendation ranks the play (follow-up call / medication reconciliation / home-health referral) per at-risk patient against team capacity, and a population-health lead approves — turning governed lakehouse data into a coordinator action, with PHI kept inside the governed boundary and the assistant's AI spend bounded on thin margins.
